<noinclude>
Stores and displays one OpenAlex topic. The call to this template is written by the upload bot
between the <code>BOT:BEGIN openalex</code> and <code>BOT:END openalex</code> markers; edits there are overwritten.
Everything outside the markers belongs to the curators.

{{#cargo_declare:_table=Topics
|openalex_id=String
|name=String
|description=Text
|keywords=List (;) of String
|subfield=Page
|subfield_id=String
|field=Page
|field_id=String
|domain=Page
|domain_id=String
|works_share=Float
|citations_share=Float
|works_permille=Float
|works_count=Integer
|cited_by_count=Integer
|wikipedia=URL
}}
</noinclude><includeonly>{{#cargo_store:_table=Topics
|openalex_id={{{openalex_id|}}}
|name={{{name|}}}
|description={{{description|}}}
|keywords={{{keywords|}}}
|subfield={{{subfield|}}}
|subfield_id={{{subfield_id|}}}
|field={{{field|}}}
|field_id={{{field_id|}}}
|domain={{{domain|}}}
|domain_id={{{domain_id|}}}
|works_share={{{works_share|}}}
|citations_share={{{citations_share|}}}
|works_permille={{{works_permille|}}}
|works_count={{{works_count|}}}
|cited_by_count={{{cited_by_count|}}}
|wikipedia={{{wikipedia|}}}
}}<div style="font-size:90%; margin-bottom:0.5em;">[[{{{domain}}}]] › [[{{{field}}}]] › [[{{{subfield}}}]] › '''{{{name}}}'''</div>
{| class="wikitable" style="float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 1em 1em; width:22em;"

== Publication types (DFG survey) ==
''Inherited from the subfield [[{{{subfield}}}]].''
{{#cargo_query:tables=DFGPublicationTypes
|fields=review_board=board,area=area,monographs=mono,anthology_contributions=anthology,journal_articles=journal,preprints=preprints,non_publisher=nonpub,data_publications=data,software=software,patents=patents,audio_visual=av,images_graphs=images,alternative=alt,other=other
|where=subfield_ids HOLDS '{{{subfield_id}}}'
|format=template
|template=DFG profile
|named args=yes
|default=''No DFG review board is assigned to this subfield.''
}}
